card.name: Starting TB treatment after latent TB test
card.fires_on: The word that begins an instruction to start treatment (start, initiate, initial) right after a latent TB test or screening sentence in biologic drug warnings. Also the semicolon after 'test for latent TB'.

modes.label: Start treatment after positive test
modes.description: The verb 'start' or 'Init(iate)' after 'if positive,' or after a test-for-latent-TB sentence.
modes.example: Perform test for latent TB; if positive,<< start>> treatment for TB prior to starting REN

modes.label: Initial in testing sentences
modes.description: The word 'initial' in a sentence about when a test may be done.
modes.example: Testing may be performed at any time from<< initial>> diagnosis and does not need to be repeated

card.writes: It pushes the model toward screening and testing words, as in the next step of a screening instruction.
card.plain: It fires on the word that begins the 'start treatment' step right after a TB screening instruction in drug warnings.
